messages:
sophia: quick update: v3.0-int4 quiet burn shows mrr_code drop 1.2% at 30m window, heatmap shows two hot slices: code-js and code-python.

mike: any sample examples? want to eyeball diffs.

sophia: posting 10 exemplars for code-js -> https://ops.internal/samples/1743239010. look at answer truncation pattern.

ada: suggest we tweak tokenization merge threshold for code tokens in quant runtime, maybe reduce aggressive merging causing token shifts. Lukas, can runtime team do a quick patch?

ben: we can try a runtime token-stitch patch in canary as a soft experiment, but patching runtime mid-rollout risky. alternative: add per-slice bias correction layer (post-processing) for known code tokens.

mike: bias correction seems lower risk to test quickly. we should add as a staged toggle in canary config.

sophia: agree. will try bias-correction for code-js only, rerun quiet burn.

deploy-bot: updated canary config with slice-level postproc toggle. canary-controller v1.15 applied.

mike: good. keep monitoring KL and hallucination. if hallucination increases, abort.

ada: also logging: add 'why' field for any automatic action in incident notes so postmortem easier.

sophia: noted. continuing watch for next 2 windows.
